story_info.title: Penny Penguin's Snowy Shores Stretches
story_info.subtitle: A morning of movement and fun!
story_info.moral: Moving our bodies helps us feel strong and happy.

main_character.name: Penny Penguin
main_character.appearance: Penny is a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet. She has rosy cheeks and a cheerful, energetic stance.

cover.prompt: A cheerful Penny Penguin, a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet, rosy cheeks, in a sunny morning scene at Snowy Shores. She is stretching her flippers high, smiling brightly. Pixar-quality 3D, soft lighting, pastel colours, children's book illustration, vertical composition, Instagram friendly.
cover.visual_action: Penny Penguin stretching and smiling brightly

slides.title: A Sunny Saturday Morning
slides.text: Penny Penguin woke up. It was a bright Saturday morning. She smiled big. "Healthy habits make every day fun!" she said. Penny loved to move her body. She went to Snowy Shores. The cool air felt nice. Time for morning exercises!
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Penny and her excitement for exercise.

slides.title: Stretch and Wiggle
slides.text: First, Penny stretched her flippers high. Up, up, up! Then she touched her toes. Down, down, down! She wiggled her body. Left, right, left. It felt so good to move. Her feathers gently swayed. She felt awake and ready.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Penny doing simple, happy stretches.

slides.title: A Wobbly Hop
slides.text: Next, Penny tried to hop on one foot. Hop, hop, hop! This was a little tricky. She wobbled a bit. Oh dear! Her flippers went out to help. She giggled. Staying balanced was hard. But Penny did not give up.
slides.speaker_notes: Present a small, gentle challenge for Penny.

slides.title: Finding Her Balance
slides.text: Penny took a deep breath. She tried again, very slowly. She kept her eyes steady. One foot up. Two flippers out. Yes! She stood still. Penny balanced! She felt very proud. Hopping was fun now. She even twirled around.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Penny overcoming the challenge with a creative solution.

slides.title: Happy and Strong
slides.text: Penny finished her exercises. She felt strong and happy. Her body felt ready for the day. Her mind felt clear and bright. "Moving my body is the best!" she chirped. Healthy habits truly make every day fun!
slides.speaker_notes: Conclude with Penny feeling happy and strong after her exercise.
